fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-08-19, the complainant scanned a QR code shared by a caller who spoke of a refund, and Rs. 9,900 was debited instead. The time of the incident was given as 00:25 on 2025-08-16. The online submission was made by Babu Rajan (9000000365). An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100018. Ramesh Pandian (9000000469) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The person involved was not identified; the number 9000000154 was noted as potentially relevant.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, college road, witness, mobile number, night, receiving account, bank reference
